svg.title: Four primary seed-42 checkpoint sweeps and the E4B JO seed-43 replicate
svg.text: Checkpoint sweeps: four primary runs and one seed-43 replicate
Solid + dots: test F1. Dashed: validation F1. Dotted gray: production (96.95%). Lower plots: validation loss.
Selection symbols mark test F1; a square also marks the chosen validation loss. The final checkpoint is step 2298.
